entities.summary: Danielle "Hopi" Elisabeth Hoekstra is an evolutionary biologist at Harvard University, where she is Dean of the Harvard Faculty of Arts and Sciences. Her lab uses natural populations of rodents to study the genetic basis of adaptation.
